isMainAdIds.description: If true, loads primary MainAdIds first.

isSubAdIds.description: If true, loads fallback SubAdIds if Main fails or if isMainAdIds is false.

isShowAdsURL.description: Controls whether custom web fallback ads are active.

MainAdIds.description: JSON bundle of production primary AdMob / Ad Manager Unit IDs.

SubAdIds.description: JSON bundle of secondary fallback AdMob / Ad Manager Unit IDs.

AdsURL.description: Default target landing URL for web promotional ads.

AdsImgClickURl.description: Target click URL for promotional image/card redirection.

clickCount.description: Click threshold for Interstitial Ads inside the Downloader app.

app_open_click_count.description: Threshold for App Open Ad on launch.

app_open_resume_count.description: Threshold for App Open Ad on app resume.

is_app_open_on_resume.description: Enable or disable App Open Ad when returning to the app from background.

isLauncherAdsShow.description: Global master switch for Launcher Ads. If false, launcher operates completely ad-free.

launcherClickCount.description: Number of app launches/item clicks in Launcher before triggering an ad.

isLauncherWebAdShow.description: If true, launcher alternates between Interstitial Ad and Web Ad URL redirection on reaching click count. If false, always shows Interstitial Ad.
